The WALAAH Standard.

Four things we hold ourselves to in every property.

CleanDaily room cleaning and regular housekeeping keep every space fresh.
Safe24/7 CCTV surveillance, a fire safety system and secure entry.
ReliablePower backup, 24/7 hot water and high-speed Wi-Fi.
TransparentRent, deposit and extra charges explained in writing before you pay.

Spaces that feel like home.

Single, double or triple sharing. Which ones are open depends on the sector.

Single sharing

A private room with your own bed, wardrobe and study desk.

Double sharing

Two beds in a room, each with its own storage space.

Triple sharing

Three beds, with study desks and a common wardrobe.

About us

Feel like home, in a new city.

PG WALAAH runs its own co-living PG accommodations across Noida: 8 properties in Sectors 59, 63, 66 and 70. We built them for students and working professionals who want a comfortable place to live, without the guesswork.

We manage every property ourselves, so the team that answers your call is the team that looks after your stay. Moving to a new city is hard enough. Your room should not be.

Questions, answered.

About PG WALAAH

Is PG WALAAH a listing website?

No. We run our own PG accommodations in Noida. You deal directly with our team.

Where are your properties?

Noida Sector 59, Sector 63, Sector 66 and Sector 70.

Rent and payments

What is the starting rent?

Rooms start from ₹8,000 a month. The final rate depends on the building, sharing type and availability.

What is included in the rent, and what is extra?

It can vary by property and room. We give you the full list of inclusions and any extra charges in writing before you pay.

What are the deposit and payment terms?

These depend on the property and room. Our team shares the deposit, notice period and refund terms before you book.

Rooms and facilities

Are your PGs for boys or girls?

Our properties are co-living. One property in Sector 63 is exclusively for girls. Tell us your sector and we will confirm which property suits you.

What room types are offered?

Single, double and triple sharing rooms. Availability differs by building, so choose a sector and we will tell you what is open there.

What facilities will I find?

Air-conditioned rooms with a bed and mattress, wardrobe, study desk and attached bathroom. Daily meals, a kitchen, dining area, refrigerator, RO water and a washing machine. Wi-Fi, power backup, lift, CCTV, fire safety and secure entry. Parking is available at select properties. See the full list under Facilities.

Booking and visits

Can I visit before booking?

Yes. Send your enquiry on WhatsApp and we will arrange a visit.

What happens after I send an enquiry?

You send a ready-made message on WhatsApp. Our team replies with availability, rates and a visit time.

What documents do I need?

We will tell you which documents are needed when you book. You are not asked for any on this website.

Visit us.

Our office is at BH 118, Sector 70, Noida. Come by, or ask us to arrange a visit to the PG that suits you.
